---
title: "Contribute"
subtitle: "Propose a problem, or leave a suggestion"
---

BENQODHI is being built in the open. Suggestions on how to organise the workshop, the
benchmark problems, or the repository itself are welcome from anyone — not only
workshop participants.

## Propose a problem

If you have a candidate optimisation problem from health or biology that could become
a BENQODHI benchmark, use the [common template](problems/index.qmd#common-template)
and open it as a GitHub Discussion.

<!-- Update this link once the repository location is confirmed -->
[Open the Discussions board →](https://github.com/<org>/benqodhi/discussions)

## Leave a suggestion

The Discussions board is also the shared place to leave ideas on:

- how the Day 2 working tables should be organised,
- possible problems for the Day 2 round table,
- anything else about the workshop or the repository.

## Prefer not to use GitHub?

Reply by email to the organisers and we will post on your behalf:
[JRC-F7-CONFERENCES@ec.europa.eu](mailto:JRC-F7-CONFERENCES@ec.europa.eu)
